verses.ar:
Maula ya salli wasallam daaye man abadan
Alaa habibibeka khaire khalqihi
verses.en:
O my Lord, send blessings and peace always and forever
Upon Your Beloved, the Best of all Creation

verses.ar:
Zikr e aali waqar karte hai
Shagle parwardigaar karte hai
Unpe har dam Darood padhte hai
Ham yehi karobaar karte hai
verses.en:
They remember him with the highest reverence
They remain occupied with the Lord
Upon him they recite Durood at every moment
This is the only business we conduct

verses.ar:
Agar Darood padho momeeno kariney se
Huzoor khud hi chaley aayege Madine se
Tum unse door ho lekin wo tumse door nahi
Yaki na aaye tau unko pukaar kar dekho
verses.en:
If you recite Durood with sincerity, O believers
The Prophet himself will come from Madina
You may be distant from him but he is never distant from you
If you doubt this — call out to him and see

verses.ar:
Samajh mai aayega imdaad kaise hoti hai
Zara tadap ke pukaaro tau ya Rasullalah
Koi dekhe tau zara unki duhayi dekar
Ya Muhammad se tau patthar bhi pighal jaate hai
verses.en:
You will understand how help truly comes
Call out with longing — O Messenger of Allah
Let anyone try calling upon him just once
For even stones melt at the name of Ya Muhammad ﷺ

verses.ar:
Tu sahebal jamal hai tu sayyedal bashar
Teri ziya hai rukh hai shabe taar ki Sahar
Laawu kaha se lab jisse teri sana karu
Mohsin kahu bashar kahu ke habib e khuda kahu
Kat jaaye saari umr tere zikre paak mai
Mil jaaye meri khaak Madine ki khaak mai
verses.en:
You are the master of beauty, the chief of mankind
Your radiant face is the dawn breaking through the darkest night
From where shall I find lips worthy to praise you?
Shall I call you Benefactor? Shall I call you human? Shall I call you the Beloved of God?
May my entire life be spent in your pure remembrance
May my dust be joined with the dust of Madina

verses.ar:
Ayse dar ka ghada hu mai jiski
Naukri taajdar karte hai
verses.en:
I am the beggar of such a door
At which kings themselves serve

verses.ar:
Muhammadun sayyedul koinain was sakalain
Wal fareeqaini min urbiw wa min ajami
verses.en:
Muhammad ﷺ is the master of both worlds and both creations
And of both groups — Arabs and non-Arabs

verses.ar:
Yaha se lekar waha tak wohi tau maalik hai
Ye qaayenaat bani hai mere Nabi ke liye
Kisi ko kuch nahi milta teri ataa ke bagair
Khuda bhi kuch nahi deta teri ataa ke bagair
verses.en:
From here to there — He alone is the Master
This entire universe was created for my Prophet ﷺ
No one receives anything without your bestowal
Even God does not give without your bestowal

verses.ar:
Har cheez musabbibe sanam se mango
Minnat se khusamat se adab se mango
Jo maangne ka tariqa hai Uss tarah mango
Ya rabbe bil Mustafa ballig maqasadana
Wag fir lana ma maada ya waasi al karami
verses.en:
Seek everything through the Beloved
Seek with supplication, with love, with reverence
Seek in the manner that is befitting of asking
O Lord, through Mustafa ﷺ fulfil our aims
And forgive what has passed, O Most Generous

verses.ar:
Summar rida an Abi Bakriw wa na Umar
Wa an Aliw wa an Usman zil karami
verses.en:
And be pleased with Abu Bakr and Umar
And with Ali and Uthman, the possessor of generosity
